text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
*gasp*... *wheeze*...
*pant*... Ahhh...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
*pant*...
I wonnnn!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Everyone!
I won!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text: ...T-That was so scaaary~!

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Yukino-chan, you had such a fierce glare ahead, didn't you?
Where did the "Snow Angel" go!?

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan B
text_block_list.text:
It was completely different from what I imagined.
Races aren't cute at all...

text_block_list.name: Trendy Fan B
text_block_list.text: —I guess... I don't really care anymore...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huh...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
W-Whaaat...!?
Why...—

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"Harp Alpha~~!
Good work~~!!"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
That was a great race, you've still got plenty in you!
I'm looking forward to autumn too!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
(If I can beat her, something will change.
Believing that... I gave it my absolute all.)

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Did I...
make a mistake somewhere?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"What makes that girl and me
so different, I wonder—"

Yukino Bijin brilliantly defeated a formidable rival.
Yet, when she returned, she wore
a bewildered look on her face.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thank ye kindly!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah,
I won!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Even so, if there are people who felt let down,
it just means my victory wasn't decisive enough.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't running the kind of cool race
that I'd always looked up to.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"So all I gotta do is work hard
and win at the Shuka Sho, too!"
The final race of the Triple Tiara, the Shuka Sho. If she proves her strength here too, Yukino Bijin's status will become unshakable.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
If I put on a wicked-cool race,
maybe the folks I let down
will come around and love me again.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Right?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Could you say a few words to the fans watching on TV, then?
Oh, in your dialect, please!

The cause likely lies in the gap between who she is and what others expect of her.
Bridging that gap is difficult.
Even so, she is striving to move forward with a positive mindset.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"...Um!
I have a favor to ask."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"To get results at the Shuka Sho,
I'd like to run in one more race before that."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Because I want to hold on forever
to this feeling of not wanting to lose...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Do ya think... there are any good races for me?
In this race with Senior Class runners competing, we can test her strength. It should give Yukino Bijin a boost of confidence before the Shuka Sho.
choice_data_list: We're in the middle of summer camp, so we'll have to travel, but...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine,
I'm used to long trips!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
An' I'm definitely,
absolutely gonna win that race!

And so, before taking on our next target, the Shuka Sho...
we decided to challenge the Queen Stakes first.

"—This year's Yushun Himba winner is Yukino Bijin!
Victory goes to the regional Umamusume, Yukino Bijin!"

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
...Incredible.
You're amazing, Yuki-chan.

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I've never seen her look so desperate before...
It's way too cool. It's just not fair...

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
—I've gotta hold on tight and keep pushing too.
To make my dream come true, just like Yuki-chan...!
